issues.title_en: Monsoon rains flood Manila homes, submerge roads in northern Philippines
issues.summary: Floodwaters submerged homes and inundated roads in Manila on Monday, as the southwest monsoon, known locally as "Habagat," brought heavy rains across the Philippines' northern island of Luzon.
